wp-calc.alt: A plant cell in a beaker of sucrose solution. The beaker: 0.3 M sucrose at 22 °C, open, so pressure potential 0 and water potential −7.4 bars. The cell: solute potential −9.0 bars and pressure potential +3.0 bars, so water potential −6.0 bars. An arrow shows net water moving out of the cell, from −6.0 toward −7.4 bars.
